notes: Excluded presentation concerns C6, C14, C23 (no novelty concerns listed). Referees reviewed v1 (match_note), so fixed_in_v1 is false throughout; C10, C11, C25 cite SI figures absent from v1, yet B still raised C25 from the main-text Te claim. B covers far more referee concerns (raised: C1, C2, C4, C5, C7, C8, C16, C22, C25; partly: C12, C13, C17, C18, C20) than A (raised: C1, C4, C8; partly: C2, C21). Judgment calls: B on C17 counted partly because the pi prefactor rests on the same step-like modulation assumption the harmonics test checks; B's omega-tau point not counted for C21 (no request for other frequencies or rectification); A's 'single temperature rise across all fillings' question not counted for C25 (it uses filling-independent Te as a test, not as an implausibility). Absolute Pmax/power requests in both reviews match C23 (presentation, excluded) so are not listed as extras. Both reviews independently flag the rho0-subtraction exponent issue and impurity screening, which no referee raised.
